```bash
git -C /work/app/.worktrees/config-loader add -- doc/plans/2026-03-02-config-loader.md && git -C /work/app/.worktrees/config-loader commit -q -m "resume: plan citation repair - 5 findings" -- doc/plans/2026-03-02-config-loader.md
```
This exits 0.

## Return to the call table (from `skip plan R`)

1. `phase_tracker skip plan` with reason `resume: pasted brief`. No brief file path was supplied, so R takes the "pasted brief" form.
2. `phase_tracker start implement`.
3. There is no `substep` call, because the brief shows `→ implement` with no substep.
4. Before `init`, I check feasibility. The single `○` task trails all non-pending tasks, so pending-suffix order holds. Not every task is complete or skipped, so the auto-complete edge does not apply.
5. `plan_tracker init` with the brief's snapshot, verbatim:
   ```

    { name: "W1: Validate schema", status: "complete" },
    { name: "W2: Wire CLI flag", status: "in_progress" },
    { name: "W3: Document the loader", status: "pending" }]
   ```

## Printed lines

```
Repaired plan: 5 findings (quote-integrity)
Gate history not restored; re-validating `W2: Wire CLI flag` before any stage advance
```
